# Warp points (generated by tools/warp_points.py - do not edit)

Every place below is a spot the game itself puts the party on (taken from door / entrance records), so warping there with the F9 menu should never leave you inside a wall. The F9 menu's WARP LIST page has the same list in the same order (# = the number the menu shows top right); the WARP page takes the numbers by hand.

**Story point** says where the place belongs in the game. The story has a common start, then splits into two routes: the **SEBEC route** (the main story) and the **Snow Queen quest** (set in the school). Warping into a later part of the story than your save does not move the story forward: events, doors and party members still follow your save's story flags, so a place can look empty or have doors that do nothing. The section *Areas in story order* below explains each area.

* **2D** = overworld map (S2D). Map numbers 0-6 are the overworld map files 2DLTS0n; the game swaps 0 -> 1 -> 2 and 3 -> 5 -> 6 by itself as the story goes on, so the numbers below can show a different stage of the same town. X/Y = 0-199.
* **3D** = first-person area / dungeon (DNG). Map = dungeon file D<map>.BIN (hex), floor 0 = first floor.
* Dir = the direction value the game stores (0-3); which way it faces was not checked.
* A warp only starts from the overworld or from a first-person area (not during story scenes, battles or menus).

## Overworld map versions

All seven are the town of Mikage-cho. The game picks the version from the story flags; warping to map 0 or 3 lands on whichever stage your save has reached.

| 2D map | When | Area entrances on it |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Mikage-cho; the game shows version 0, 1 or 2 by story progress | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway station, Abandoned factory tunnel |
| 1 | Mikage-cho, after story flag 0x14 | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway station |
| 2 | Mikage-cho, after story flag 0x27 | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway station, Abandoned factory tunnel |
| 3 | Mikage-cho, SEBEC route; the game shows version 3, 5 or 6 by story progress | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Abandoned factory tunnel, Mikage ruins, Mikage subway (west / east) |
| 4 | Mikage-cho, SEBEC route (Castle, Haunted Mansion, Black Market) | Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway (west / east), Black Market, Haunted Mansion |
| 5 | Mikage-cho, SEBEC route, after flag 0x67 | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway station, Abandoned factory tunnel, Mikage ruins, Mikage subway (west / east) |
| 6 | Mikage-cho, SEBEC route, after flag 0x6E (Araya) | Joy-dori, Mikage Sun Mall, Mikage subway station, Mikage ruins, Mikage subway (west / east), Araya cave (Araya Shrine) |
